concerns.note: Full pnpm -r test / pnpm build could not be run clean locally: Node v26.4.0 is installed but .nvmrc pins 22.19.0. This mismatch reproduces three independent-looking symptoms -- jsdom localStorage shadowing (known, see prior session memory), a vite/Rollup bare-specifier resolution failure in the simulator vendor tree, and a crew-lint EISDIR crash -- plus a genuine phantom @keymanapp/keyman-version dependency gap (declared nowhere in packages/engine/package.json, only reachable transitively through @keymanapp/kmc-kmn under strict pnpm linking) that surfaces once engine/dist is freshly rebuilt from current source. None of this is caused by or specific to langtags-defaults; CI is green on main for this exact commit. Recommend: switch to Node 22.19.0 locally (or fix the toolchain) before trusting pnpm -r test/build results on this branch, and separately track the @keymanapp/keyman-version dependency gap (likely introduced by the already-merged spec-062 simulator context-seeding work) as its own fix.
